preBuildScripts.name: Build OrlixKernel Archive
preBuildScripts.script:
set -eu
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/lld/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"
profile="${ORLIX_PROFILE:-release}"
platform="${PLATFORM_NAME:?}"
build_root="${ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT:-$SRCROOT/Build}"
case "$platform" in
    iphoneos|iphonesimulator) ;;
    *) echo "unsupported OrlixKernel archive platform: $platform" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
if [ "${ORLIX_XCODE_SKIP_COMPONENT_PREBUILDS:-NO}" != YES ]; then
    "${MAKE:-make}" -f "$SRCROOT/OrlixKernel/Makefile" __kernel-archive PROFILE="$profile" ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT="$build_root" ORLIX_KERNEL_ARCHIVE_PLATFORMS="$platform"
else
    echo "Skipping OrlixKernel rebuild for a noncanonical local Xcode compile."
fi
archive="$build_root/OrlixKernel/$profile/$platform/OrlixKernel.a"
if [ ! -s "$archive" ]; then
    echo "missing OrlixKernel archive: $archive" >&2
    exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET_TEMP_DIR"
if [ ! -s "$TARGET_TEMP_DIR/OrlixKernel.a" ] || ! cmp -s "$archive" "$TARGET_TEMP_DIR/OrlixKernel.a"; then
    cp -f "$archive" "$TARGET_TEMP_DIR/OrlixKernel.a"
else
    echo "Reusing unchanged OrlixKernel archive."
fi

preBuildScripts.name: Build OrlixMLibC Linux Sysroot
preBuildScripts.script:
set -eu
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/lld/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"
unset SDKROOT IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET TVOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET WATCHOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET
profile="${ORLIX_PROFILE:-release}"
build_root="${ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT:-$SRCROOT/Build}"
if [ "${ORLIX_XCODE_SKIP_COMPONENT_PREBUILDS:-NO}" != YES ]; then
    "${MAKE:-make}" -f "$SRCROOT/OrlixMLibC/Makefile" build PROFILE="$profile" ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT="$build_root"
else
    test -d "$build_root/OrlixMLibC/sysroot/$profile" || {
        echo "missing prebuilt OrlixMLibC sysroot for profile $profile" >&2
        exit 1
    }
    echo "Using the existing OrlixMLibC sysroot for a noncanonical local Xcode compile."
fi

postBuildScripts.name: Embed OrlixOS Resources
postBuildScripts.script:
set -eu
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/lld/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"
unset SDKROOT IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET TVOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET WATCHOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET
build_root="${ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT:-$SRCROOT/Build}"
ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT="$build_root"
if [ "${ORLIX_OS_SKIP_PAYLOAD_EMBED:-NO}" = YES ]; then
    echo "Skipping OrlixOS payload embed because ORLIX_OS_SKIP_PAYLOAD_EMBED=YES"
    exit 0
fi
profile="${ORLIX_PROFILE:-release}"
ORLIX_OS_PAYLOAD_SOURCE_ROOT="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixKernel/resource-staging"
ORLIX_OS_ROOT_INITRAMFS_INPUT="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixOS/rootfs/$profile/rootfs/initramfs.cpio.gz"
ORLIX_OS_BASE_ROOT_TREE_INPUT="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixOS/rootfs/$profile/base-tree"
ORLIX_OS_STATE_ROOT_TREE_INPUT="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixOS/rootfs/$profile/state-tree"
payload="$ORLIX_OS_PAYLOAD_SOURCE_ROOT/$profile"
if [ "${ORLIX_OS_EXPECTED_ROOTFS_INPUT+x}" = x ]; then
    expected_rootfs_input="$ORLIX_OS_EXPECTED_ROOTFS_INPUT"
else
    expected_rootfs_input="$ORLIX_OS_ROOT_INITRAMFS_INPUT"
fi
if [ "${ORLIX_OS_EXPECTED_BASE_ROOT_TREE_INPUT+x}" = x ]; then
    expected_base_root_tree_input="$ORLIX_OS_EXPECTED_BASE_ROOT_TREE_INPUT"
else
    expected_base_root_tree_input="$ORLIX_OS_BASE_ROOT_TREE_INPUT"
fi
if [ "${ORLIX_OS_EXPECTED_STATE_ROOT_TREE_INPUT+x}" = x ]; then
    expected_state_root_tree_input="$ORLIX_OS_EXPECTED_STATE_ROOT_TREE_INPUT"
else
    expected_state_root_tree_input="$ORLIX_OS_STATE_ROOT_TREE_INPUT"
fi
stamp="$payload/.orlix-payload-ready"
payload_needs_rebuild=0
if [ ! -d "$payload" ] || [ ! -s "$stamp" ]; then
    payload_needs_rebuild=1
else
    rootfs_input="$(sed -n 's/^rootfs_input=//p' "$stamp")"
    base_root_tree_input="$(sed -n 's/^base_root_tree_input=//p' "$stamp")"
    state_root_tree_input="$(sed -n 's/^state_root_tree_input=//p' "$stamp")"
    if [ "$rootfs_input" != "$expected_rootfs_input" ] ||
       { [ -n "$expected_base_root_tree_input" ] && [ "$base_root_tree_input" != "$expected_base_root_tree_input" ]; } ||
       { [ -n "$expected_state_root_tree_input" ] && [ "$state_root_tree_input" != "$expected_state_root_tree_input" ]; }; then
        payload_needs_rebuild=1
    fi
fi
if [ "$payload_needs_rebuild" = 1 ]; then
    "${MAKE:-make}" -f "$SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Makefile" kernel-payload PROFILE="$profile" ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT"
else
  payload_inputs="
    $SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Makefile
    $SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Sources/distribution/manifest.mk
    $SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Sources/distribution/target-settings.xcconfig
    $SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Sources/init/init.c
    $SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Sources/init/console_policy.c
    $SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Sources/init/console_policy.h
  $SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Sources/init/rootinit.c
  $SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Sources/make/config.mk
  $SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Sources/make/packages.mk
  $SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Sources/make/rootfs.mk
  $SRCROOT/OrlixKernel/Makefile
  $SRCROOT/OrlixKernel/Sources/ports/orlix/configs
  $SRCROOT/OrlixKernel/Sources/ports/orlix/kbuild/kernel-rules.mk
  $SRCROOT/OrlixKernel/Sources/ports/orlix/kbuild/product-compile-adapter.mk
  $SRCROOT/OrlixKernel/Sources/ports/orlix/overlay
  $SRCROOT/OrlixKernel/Sources/ports/orlix/patches
              "
    for payload_input in $payload_inputs; do
        if [ -e "$payload_input" ] && [ "$payload_input" -nt "$stamp" ]; then
            payload_needs_rebuild=1
            break
        fi
    done
    if [ "$payload_needs_rebuild" = 1 ]; then
    "${MAKE:-make}" -f "$SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Makefile" kernel-payload PROFILE="$profile" ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT"
    fi
fi
if [ ! -d "$payload" ]; then
    echo "missing staged OrlixOS resources after packaging: $payload" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -s "$stamp" ]; then
    echo "missing OrlixOS payload stamp after packaging: $stamp" >&2
    exit 1
fi
rootfs_input="$(sed -n 's/^rootfs_input=//p' "$stamp")"
base_root_tree_input="$(sed -n 's/^base_root_tree_input=//p' "$stamp")"
state_root_tree_input="$(sed -n 's/^state_root_tree_input=//p' "$stamp")"
case "$rootfs_input" in
    "$expected_rootfs_input") ;;
    *)
        echo "OrlixOS payload is not packaged from the expected rootfs: $rootfs_input" >&2
        echo "expected: $expected_rootfs_input" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
if [ -n "$expected_base_root_tree_input" ]; then
    case "$base_root_tree_input" in
        "$expected_base_root_tree_input") ;;
        *)
            echo "OrlixOS payload is missing the expected base root tree: $base_root_tree_input" >&2
            echo "expected: $expected_base_root_tree_input" >&2
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
fi
if [ -n "$expected_state_root_tree_input" ]; then
    case "$state_root_tree_input" in
        "$expected_state_root_tree_input") ;;
        *)
            echo "OrlixOS payload is missing the expected state root tree: $state_root_tree_input" >&2
            echo "expected: $expected_state_root_tree_input" >&2
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
fi
destination="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH"
"${MAKE:-make}" -f "$SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Makefile" __sync-payload ORLIX_PAYLOAD_SOURCE="$payload" ORLIX_PAYLOAD_DESTINATION="$destination"

postBuildScripts.name: Embed Orlix Upstream Test Rootfs Bundles
postBuildScripts.script:
set -eu
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/lld/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"
profile="${ORLIX_PROFILE:-release}"
build_root="${ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT:-$SRCROOT/Build}"
ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT="$build_root"
rebuild_kselftest_if_stale() {
  source_root="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixMLibC/test-initramfs/$profile/$ORLIX_OS_KSELFTEST_INITRAMFS_BUNDLE_NAME.$extension"
  archive="$source_root/rootfs/initramfs.cpio.gz"
    needs_rebuild=0
    if [ ! -s "$archive" ]; then
        needs_rebuild=1
    elif find "$SRCROOT/OrlixKernel/Sources/ports/orlix/overlay/tools/testing/selftests/orlix" -type f \( -name '*.c' -o -name '*.h' -o -name Makefile \) -newer "$archive" -print -quit | grep -q .; then
        needs_rebuild=1
    elif [ "$SRCROOT/OrlixKernel/Sources/ports/orlix/kbuild/kernel-rules.mk" -nt "$archive" ]; then
        needs_rebuild=1
    fi
  if [ "$needs_rebuild" -eq 1 ]; then
      make -f "$SRCROOT/OrlixKernel/Makefile" kselftest PROFILE="$profile" ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT" libc=orlixmlibc
  fi
}
rebuild_mlibc_if_stale() {
  source_root="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixMLibC/test-initramfs/$profile/$ORLIX_OS_MLIBC_INITRAMFS_BUNDLE_NAME.$extension"
  archive="$source_root/rootfs/initramfs.cpio.gz"
  needs_rebuild=0
  if [ ! -s "$archive" ]; then
      needs_rebuild=1
  elif [ "$SRCROOT/OrlixMLibC/Makefile" -nt "$archive" ]; then
      needs_rebuild=1
  elif find "$SRCROOT/OrlixMLibC/Tests" "$SRCROOT/OrlixMLibC/Sources" -type f \( -name '*.c' -o -name '*.h' -o -name '*.hpp' -o -name '*.patch' -o -name Makefile \) -newer "$archive" -print -quit | grep -q .; then
      needs_rebuild=1
  elif [ -s "$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixMLibC/sysroot/$profile/.orlixmlibc-sysroot-ready" ] && [ "$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixMLibC/sysroot/$profile/.orlixmlibc-sysroot-ready" -nt "$archive" ]; then
      needs_rebuild=1
  fi
  if [ "$needs_rebuild" -eq 1 ]; then
      make -f "$SRCROOT/OrlixMLibC/Makefile" test-initramfs PROFILE="$profile" ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT"
  fi
}
copy_if_present() {
  source="$1"
  name="$2"
    destination="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/$name"
    if [ -d "$source" ]; then
        rm -rf "$destination"
        cp -R "$source" "$destination"
    fi
}
extension="${ORLIX_OS_TEST_INITRAMFS_BUNDLE_EXTENSION:?}"
rebuild_kselftest_if_stale
rebuild_mlibc_if_stale
copy_if_present "$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixMLibC/test-initramfs/$profile/$ORLIX_OS_KSELFTEST_INITRAMFS_BUNDLE_NAME.$extension" "$ORLIX_OS_KSELFTEST_INITRAMFS_BUNDLE_NAME.$extension"
copy_if_present "$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixMLibC/test-initramfs/$profile/$ORLIX_OS_MLIBC_INITRAMFS_BUNDLE_NAME.$extension" "$ORLIX_OS_MLIBC_INITRAMFS_BUNDLE_NAME.$extension"
copy_if_present "$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixOS/test-initramfs/$profile/$ORLIX_OS_COREUTILS_INITRAMFS_BUNDLE_NAME.$extension" "$ORLIX_OS_COREUTILS_INITRAMFS_BUNDLE_NAME.$extension"
if [ "${ORLIX_OS_SKIP_ENVIRONMENT_RUNTIME_FIXTURES:-NO}" != YES ]; then
    "${MAKE:-make}" -f "$SRCROOT/OrlixOS/Makefile" environment-runtime-test-fixtures PROFILE="$profile" ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT="$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT"
    copy_if_present "$ORLIX_BUILD_ROOT/OrlixOS/environment-runtime-test-fixtures" "EnvironmentRuntimeTestFixtures"
else
    rm -rf "$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/EnvironmentRuntimeTestFixtures"
fi
